subject: Procurement audit impacting MAP — proposed re-sequence and escalation
messages:
From: Maria Rodriguez <maria.rodriguez@acme-corp.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — SOC evidence request and audit window

Hi Grace / Evelyn,

Apologies for the late note — Procurement has been flagged for an external compliance audit. The security team is requesting a short window to validate our vendor controls before they allow the next evaluation milestone to proceed.

Key asks from Acme procurement:
- We need the SOC evidence packet and policy docs submitted by Oct 9 for the audit team.
- If evidence cannot be provided by then, the audit window will push our security sign-off until Oct 20.

This will affect the agreed evaluation sequence: security review -> pilot -> contract signature. Procurement is asking for a formal MAP update reflecting the new dates.

I attached the audit request they sent (Acme_SOC_Audit_Request.pdf). Let me know if you need anything from our side.

Thanks,
Maria
Procurement Lead, Acme Corp
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Maria Rodriguez <maria.rodriguez@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — SOC evidence request and audit window

Maria — thanks for flagging and for the attached PDF.

Quick internal note for visibility: Evelyn, Jonas — Acme's procurement audit pushes security sign-off out by ~10 days if we can't deliver the SOC packet by Oct 9. That directly cascades the pilot start and the signature timeline.

Proposed immediate actions (short and actionable):
1) We will compile and deliver the SOC packet (controls matrix, retention policy excerpt, audit logs sample) by Oct 8 EOD — Evelyn, can you confirm capability and ETA?
2) If we miss Oct 9, propose to re-sequence the MAP so the pilot acceptance work (non-security gating items) proceeds in parallel with the audit remediation steps. New baseline in attached spreadsheet (proposed_rebaseline.xlsx).
3) Sales escalation: if the audit pushes signature beyond Oct 20, request a 30-day extension on closing conditions and ask for a temporary pilot variance (reduced scope) — Jonas please prepare a short ask for the executive escalation (credit/extension).

I attached the current MAP export (Acme_MAP_v1.xlsx) and my proposed rebaseline.

Next steps: Evelyn to confirm SOC packet ETA, Jonas to draft the escalation ask. Maria, if procurement can provide a hard latest-allowable-date for vendor evidence submission that would help us plan.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior AM, Redwood Inference
From: Maria Rodriguez <maria.rodriguez@acme-corp.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — SOC evidence request and audit window

Grace — thanks for the quick response and for the proposed plan.

Procurement confirms: if Redwood cannot supply the SOC packet by Oct 9 close of business, the audit team will keep the vendor in review and we will not be able to sign contracts until after their audit completes. The hard audit completion date is currently Oct 20.

Acme is open to the proposed MAP re-sequence (run non-security pilot tasks in parallel) but will need a formal updated MAP and a short note from Redwood explaining what will be deferred vs. what requires security gating.

Please include the updated MAP and the explanatory note in the DocuSign envelope when you re-send the contract to Procurement.

Best,
Maria
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Procurement audit impacting MAP — proposed re-sequence and escalation

Jonas / Evelyn — forwarding the procurement thread. Summary and action items below (please treat as internal escalation).

Summary: Acme procurement's external audit forces a potential 10+ day delay to security sign-off if we cannot deliver SOC evidence by Oct 9. That will push the contract signature past our current close target (Oct 15).

Immediate asks:
- Evelyn: confirm SOC packet delivery by Oct 8 EOD and drop the security controls index into the shared Drive link. If you cannot, tell me which artifacts will ship on Oct 8 and which will be delayed.
- Jonas: draft a one-paragraph executive escalation requesting either (a) a 30-day close extension or (b) an interim reduced-scope pilot with limited data retention, plus any credit concession language. We'll route this to VP Sales and Legal for sign-off.

Proposed re-baseline (high level):
- Security packet delivery: Oct 8 -> target
- Security sign-off: Oct 20 (if packet late)
- Pilot start (re-sequenced): Oct 11 (limited-scope items only)
- Contract execution: Oct 25 (new target)

I'll prepare a short cover note for DocuSign and update the MAP workbook once Evelyn confirms the deliverables. Keep replies tight — we need a decision by EOD tomorrow to avoid slippage beyond Oct 25.

On quoting Maria's last email: "Acme is open to the proposed MAP re-sequence (run non-security pilot tasks in parallel) but will need a formal updated MAP and a short note from Redwood explaining what will be deferred vs. what requires security gating."

Thanks — Grace
Senior AM, Redwood Inference
